text:
Maya: Heads-up — legal asked for a migration plan to move existing tenant roles into the new scope-based model. We need a short checklist and a UX we can ship to let customers bulk-edit without downtime.
Sam: +1. Do we have an API surface for a bulk mapping import?
Liam: We do have /admin/roles/bulk_apply but it's internal and unidirectional. It expects a CSV with role_id, scope_paths, action. No dry-run currently.
Jess: Dry-run is the big ask. Customers want to preview changes, see perms that widen vs narrow. Also audit diff.
Priya: For enterprise tenants we should surface a canary option: apply to 5% of orgs (or a single team) and collect telemetry for unintended access regressions.
Maya: UX ideas: 1) CSV upload + preview diff. 2) Inline mapping editor for ambiguous matches. 3) Rollout slider (immediate / staged / canary). Keep it near Roles > Bulk edit.
Sam: Implementation notes: backend should support `preview=true` that returns list of affected principals and routes. Also return a small sample of affected API keys/service accounts.
Liam: There's also corner-case with inherited entitlements — if tenant A had role that relied on legacy group-level inheritance, mapping might expand to multiple scope nodes. Need warnings.
Jess: Can we add a validation step that detects expansion (i.e., one role => multiple new scope grants) and require explicit confirmation?
Priya: Yes, and include a CSV column `force_expand` to opt-in. Default should be conservative.
Sam: Example preview payload (what backend should return):
```json
{
  "preview": true,
  "mappings": [
    {"role_id": "r-123", "old_name": "tenant_admin", "new_scopes": ["tenant:*","routes:read"] , "impact": "expand"},
    {"role_id": "r-456", "old_name": "viewer", "new_scopes": ["routes:read"], "impact": "noop"}
  ],
  "sample_principals": ["svc-ingest-1","alice@acme.com"]
}
```
Maya: Important: telemetry. We need to track changes as events so we can correlate after rollout: permission_change.created with fields {actor, tenant, mapping_file_sha, preview_id}.
Liam: Also record metrics: num_principals_changed, percent_principals_with_new_write_access, days_to_revert_if_any. These feed into the console warning/rollback suggestions.
Jess: UI copy — call it "Bulk role migration (scope model)". Warn about access expansion and strongly recommend preview + canary for enterprise. Add a banner for tenants with SSO + SCIM saying "SCIM-managed roles will be ignored unless you opt-in".
Sam: API design question: should we expose bulk endpoint to customers or keep as admin-only via support? If we expose it, we must rate-limit and add a quota model to avoid mass accidental changes.
Priya: I vote expose with safeguards: dry-run only for self-serve, write operation requires billing tier or support override. Also quota: 10 bulk writes/day by default.
Maya: Ops notes: we need a rollback job that can undo the mapping using the stored preview_id and mapping_file_sha. Infra-bot, can you queue a small RFC job to add reversible transaction semantics?
Infra-bot: deploy-bot: queued job #4521 — "rbac: bulk-migrate reversible transactions". ETA: next sprint. :white_check_mark:
Liam: Security: service accounts used by CI will be re-evaluated. Need to ensure token-scoped expirations survive mapping.
Jess: UX: show a small sample table: "Before" vs "After" for top 10 principals and route examples. That helps product managers sign off.
Maya: Edge-case: tenants with custom roles that match no new scopes — offer a toggle to keep them as "legacy roles" for 90 days with a warning on next sign-in.
Sam: For audit logs, add `permission_change.preview_id` to every change so we can trace who approved what.
Priya: Also surface CSV templates with suggested mapping heuristics (e.g., fuzzy match on role name, fallback to admin->tenant:*).
Liam: Will need to update console tracing/telemetry to attach trace-id to bulk job so we can debug P95 latency spikes during applies.
Maya: Ok — next steps: Sam and Liam to draft API + preview payloads, Jess to mock the UI flow (CSV -> preview -> canary -> apply -> rollback), Priya to draft enterprise policy (quota + billing), I'll own the product checklist for legal.
Sam: I'll open a proposal PR with the API contract and add `preview` flag + `canary_percent`.
Jess: I'll put mobile/console mocks in figma and link in the PR.
Priya: I'll coordinate with sales/CS for communication plan.
Maya: Thanks all. If anyone wants to add sample CSV headers: suggested headers are `role_id,old_name,new_scope_paths,force_expand,owner_email`.
Sam: :eyes: I'll include that in the API PR.
Liam: :+1:
Jess: :shipit:
Priya: :raised_hands:
